acceptanceCriteria: The ledgers remain never an input to live ranking; only an admitted learned trace, produced by an explicit command and gated by the held-out evaluation, can change slot weights.
The gate reports the held-out delta and refuses admission on no improvement; the refusal is recorded in BUILD-LOG.
Rollback to the default weights is one command and is tested.
body: Owner requested the 2026-09 state-of-the-art gap review items as part of Corvint 0.7.0 on 2026-09-22. This ticket records release intent, not delivery or promotion. Original Go implementation; extend the cited existing mechanisms and preserve the existing public wires. Before implementation is called complete, update the owning indexed spec with stable requirements, non-goals, failure modes, acceptance evidence and rollback, and finish normal CEM/OCM, independent review and mandatory gates. Current state: `.corvint/unplanned-reads.jsonl` and the self-observation ledger exist, but RELEASE-NOTES records the learning loop as having no measured consumer, and product invariant 4 forbids the ledgers from feeding ranking directly. Add an explicit, operator-invoked, evaluation-gated learning step that reads the ledgers as negative labels, proposes slot-order weights as a learned trace, and admits them only through the frozen held-out gate. Prior art: Cursor semantic-search training method. Owning specs: docs/specs/learned-trace-admission-v0.md, docs/specs/context-evolution-program-v0.md.

completion.reason: Delivered through PR #92 (merged by the owner 2026-09-23, main c5f3dfd): corvint eval --learn-slot-weights/--reset-slot-weights, LTA-V0-009..012, BUILD-LOG 2026-09-23 V1-0088. AC1: ledgers are read only by the explicit eval step; context/query never open them. AC2: held-out delta reported, admission refused on no improvement, refusal recorded in BUILD-LOG. AC3: one-command reset, tested. Decision 0368 was filed as proposed; the owner merged the PR, but the decision text has not been amended to accepted. NOT_RUN: full-gate at c5f3dfd (focused tests, vet and the focused docs checks ran).

title: learning: use unplanned-read and re-read ledgers as negative labels for slot weights
